company_name: Zhejiang Sanhua Intelligent Controls Co., Ltd.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (3yr 34.9%, 5yr 25.8%) diverges >30% from revenue/EPS CAGRs (12.7-20.7%) because the June 2025 H-share IPO added RMB ~8.4bn of new equity. Ex-IPO the 3yr equity CAGR is about 21%. Revenue 3yr CAGR selected as the cleaner organic anchor; the forward base path (4% FY2026, peaking at 9%) sits well below it because H1 FY2026 decelerated to +3.9%.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest income. FY2020: 938.0 - 72.8 - 52.2 = 813.0; FY2024: 736.0 - 109.1 - 130.3 = 496.6; FY2025: 1,753.0 - 115.3 - 262.6 = 1,375.1. The 5yr owner-FCF CAGR of 11.1% is below the reported-FCF CAGR of 13.3%, mainly because interest income on the IPO cash pile grew, not SBC. The 3yr FCF CAGR is null because FY2021-FY2023 capex is not populated in Metrics.csv. Reported FCF was depressed in FY2024-25 by an overseas capacity build (capex 10-12% of revenue). TTM to H1 FY2026: reported FCF is about RMB 3.2bn, as capex eased to 8.1% of revenue.

scenario_narratives.base: Steady mid/high-single-digit compounding: HVAC component share gains and heat-pump/refrigerant upgrades outside China offset a flat post-subsidy China AC market, NEV thermal-management content keeps growing, and data-centre liquid cooling contributes from FY2027. Margins hold ~20.5% pre-SBC; capex normalises to ~5% as the overseas plant build completes; no robotics revenue is assumed.
scenario_narratives.bull: The third growth curve arrives: bionic-robot actuators reach volume with domestic humanoid OEMs and data-centre liquid cooling scales with AI capex, lifting group margin to ~22.5% and growth back to low-teens through FY2030. Tariff-displaced share flows to the Mexico/Thailand/Vietnam/Poland footprint.
scenario_narratives.bear: Price wars ('involution') in China appliances and NEV, US tariff/EV-credit headwinds, and RMB strength compress margin to ~18% while growth slows to low-single digits; robotics stays at sampling; the H1 FY2026 deceleration (+3.9% revenue, -3.1% profit) proves to be the trend rather than a pause.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the proven two-segment components franchise on its own owner cash flows (SBC expensed, interest income stripped and the cash pile added once) and treat robotics and data-centre cooling as bull-case optionality only, not as a base-case input. The H-share is valued in RMB and converted to HKD. The large A/H premium means the H-share is the cheaper line of the same claim, but the A-share price is not used as a valuation anchor.
key_risks_to_valuation: Growth path: the base case assumes reacceleration to 8-9% in FY2027-28 from +3.9% in H1 FY2026. If deceleration persists, the value moves toward bear.
Margin: China appliance/NEV price wars and RMB appreciation (H1 FY2026 FX loss of RMB 285m) could hold EBITDA below 20%.
Trade policy: US tariffs on Chinese-origin components and the EV tax-credit phase-out hit both segments; the Mexico capacity mitigates this only partly.
Tax: about 15% high-tech-enterprise status. Loss of it, or a heavier overseas mix, lifts the cash tax rate.
FX bridge: the value is computed in CNY and converted at a fixed CNYHKD rate that refresh_price.py does not update.
Optionality mispricing: the market has repeatedly re-rated the stock on humanoid-robot news (52-week range 20.66-43.66 HKD). This model gives no base-case credit for it.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (2050.HK, HKD) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 20.66-43.66. A-share 002050.SZ and CNYHKD=X from the same API, for the parity and FX checks.
data_sources.financials: HKFRS Annual Report FY2025 and Interim Report H1 FY2026 (Extracted/), CAS annual reports FY2016-FY2024 for history; Metrics.csv in CNY millions.

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted weighted average, H1 FY2026 interim note 9(b): 4,183.4M basic + 11.9M scheme shares = 4,195.3M (A + H combined; 4,208.0M issued less treasury shares held for the restricted-share schemes). Held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows. The June 2025 H-share IPO (RMB 8.53bn gross) is already in this count; no further non-SBC issuance modelled.
inputs.net_debt_note: H1 FY2026 balance sheet (30 Jun 2026, RMB'000): cash and cash equivalents 11,910,189 + term deposits and restricted cash 2,905,340 + financial assets at FVTPL (wealth-management products and listed equity instruments) 1,065,728 = 15,881.2m. Debt: borrowings 904,920 non-current + 2,817,837 current = 3,722.8m, plus lease liabilities 153,559 + 77,118 = 230.7m (treatment A, leases as debt) = 3,953.4m. Net cash 11,927.8m. The interest income those assets earn is stripped from the flows (matching-asset rule).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 Annual (HKFRS) line 7814: share-based payment expenses RMB 115,261k (equity-settled 108,090k at line 9931 plus cash-settled SARs). Equity-award taxes: none disclosed (A-share restricted-share schemes are funded by employee subscription; EquityAwardTaxes kpi = 0). H1 FY2026 SBC fell to RMB 22.4m as the 2022/2024 schemes amortise out.
inputs.interest_income_source: FY2025 Annual line 4570 finance income 194,187k + line 7730 interest income in other income 68,413k = 262.6m (matches InterestIncome kpi). H1 FY2026: 58.6m + 74.1m = 132.7m.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 repurchases RMB 313.2m (A-shares, largely for incentive schemes); H1 FY2026 nil. The flat count is partly funded by repurchases; buybacks are value-neutral in this model.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements in RMB (CNY); H-share quote in HKD. fx_rate = HKD per CNY = 1.1724 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16 22:02Z), cross-checked against USD/CNH 6.6853 and the HKD peg (~7.84/6.685 = 1.173). Direction: CNY value x 1.1724 = HKD value. Dual-listing check: the A-share 002050.SZ closed RMB 31.42 on 2026-10-16 = HKD 36.84, against the H-share close at the same date (current_price), an H-share discount of roughly 40% (A/H premium roughly 70%). That is not parity, since A and H shares are not fungible and China A/H premia of 30-100% are normal, but it confirms the direction: an inverted rate would put the A-share at HKD 26.8, which is not plausible against an A/H premium market. Valuation is computed in CNY per share and converted to HKD; refresh_price.py does not move this rate.
inputs.wacc_rationale: CNY-built, since the flows are RMB. China 10y CGB about 1.85%; China ERP about 6.5%; levered beta about 1.10 for a global component OEM supplier with export and auto-cycle exposure, giving a cost of equity of about 9.0%. The balance sheet is net cash, so WACC = CoE = 9.0%. The same rate is used in every scenario: cyclicality, trade-policy and price-war risk are carried in the scenario flows and weights, not in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities of RMB 230.7m are in total_debt. Lease principal (FY2025 104.4m) is NOT deducted from the flows, and right-of-use additions run through the capex line ('including right-of-use assets' per the cash flow statement). No lease_cost_pct_path.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is about 1.8% of profit (H1 FY2026 37.2m of 2,081.2m) and RMB 322.8m of book equity. It is charged once, in the flows, as a +1.5pp leakage folded into the cash-tax driver (0.018 x (1-0.15) of EBIT). NCI is not deducted in the bridge.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, with non-US adaptations (CNY flows / HKD quote, leases as debt, NCI via leakage, interest income stripped with matching cash in the bridge). Routed as an operating company: global #1 in refrigeration/AC control valves plus NEV thermal management; not a financial. First valuation of this ticker, so there is no prior model in memory. EBITDA margin is defined pre-SBC and ex interest income in other income: FY2025 underlying is about 19.8% ((6,092.5 - 68.4 + 115.3)/31,011.7); H1 FY2026 underlying is about 20.6% (operating profit 2,426.8 + other losses 414.2 (FX -285.5, equity-instrument FV -197.7) - interest in other income 74.1 + D&A 699.2 + SBC 22.4, on revenue 16,900). Some FX loss recurs for a net exporter during RMB appreciation, so the base starts at 20.0%, below the H1 underlying. Working capital: receivables 12.4bn + inventory 5.8bn - payables 11.1bn is about 22% of revenue, so wc_capture is -22% of the revenue increase. The analysis JSON's Tesla Optimus order rumour was denied by the company and is treated as noise: no robotics revenue is in base, and robotics plus data-centre liquid cooling appear only as mix and margin upside in bull. Year 1 = FY2026: H1 revenue +3.9% YoY and H2 FY2025 was already only +3.3%, so FY2026 base growth is 4.0%. No formal FY guidance is disclosed (the H1 report gives qualitative H2 plans only).

bear.narrative: China home-appliance 'involution' price wars persist and the post-subsidy AC downturn deepens. NEV growth stalls as the industry consolidates and US policy (tax-credit phase-out, tariffs on Chinese-origin components) erodes North American volumes despite Mexico capacity. RMB appreciation keeps generating FX losses. Robotics stays at trial production. OEM customers squeeze pricing, margins drift to 18%, and loss of high-tech-enterprise status or a heavier overseas mix pushes cash tax toward 19%.

base.narrative: Core HVAC components grow with replacement, refrigerant-transition and heat-pump demand outside China, while China residential AC stays flat after subsidies end. NEV thermal content-per-vehicle keeps compounding at high-single digits. Data-centre liquid cooling adds a modest increment from FY2027. Margins hold about 20.5% as automation offsets price wars and RMB strength. Capex normalises from the overseas build to about 5% of revenue.

bull.narrative: Robot electromechanical actuators move from sampling to volume supply with Chinese humanoid programmes and data-centre CDU and cold-plate components win hyperscaler qualifications. Both carry higher margins and lift group EBITDA to about 22.5%. Overseas plants (Mexico, Poland, Thailand, Vietnam) take tariff-displaced share. Growth reaccelerates toward the FY2021-25 low-teens rate.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: H1 FY2026 showed revenue +3.9% and attributable profit -3.1%, management itself flags continuing involution price wars into 2026, and US trade policy acts directly on both segments. Base 50%: the core franchises (global #1 in expansion and reversing valves, NEV thermal at most global OEMs) are intact and the balance sheet carries RMB 11.9bn net cash. Bull cut from 35% to 25%: it needs two unproven businesses (robot actuators still at trial production after the denied Tesla rumour, and data-centre cooling still in validation) to scale at once.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
